tutorial.intro: Do this on the TV before continuing. It takes a few minutes.

2.title: Turn on network debugging
2.body: In developer options, turn on "USB debugging" then "Network debugging" (port 5555), not wireless debugging.

3.title: Google account
3.body: For a full lock (Device Owner), first remove every account and profile from the TV, then add them back after the installation. Without this, the wizard installs a soft kiosk.

4.title: Note the IP address
4.body: Find the TV's IP address (Settings > Network); reserve it in the router.

5.title: Accept the prompt
5.body: During the installation, accept the debugging prompt on the TV and tick "Always allow".
